title: Entry, Exit, and Technological Progress in Markov-Perfect Duopoly
abstract: arXiv:2610.28440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper establishes the existence and essential uniqueness of an intuitively refined Markov-perfect equilibrium in a duopoly game with sunk costs, barriers to entry, firm-specific technological progress, and irreversible exit. We develop an algorithm that quickly computes the equilibrium by solving for fixed points of a finite sequence of auxiliary contraction mappings, which we label Fake Backward Induction. We illustrate the game's practical value with a quantitative analysis of competition policy in a stochastically growing market with firms idiosyncratically learning by aging. Computing one equilibrium of this example takes 10.2 seconds on one Apple M5 Pro core.

translated_title: 马尔可夫完美双寡头竞争中的进入、退出与技术进步
translated_abstract: 本文在一个包含沉没成本、进入壁垒、企业特有技术进步以及不可逆退出的双寡头博弈中，证明了一个经过直觉精炼的马尔可夫完美均衡的存在性与本质唯一性。我们开发了一种能够快速计算该均衡的算法，该算法通过求解有限序列辅助压缩映射的不动点来获得均衡，我们将其命名为“伪逆向归纳法”（Fake Backward Induction）。我们通过对一个随机增长市场（其中企业随经营年限进行异质性学习）中竞争政策的定量分析，展示了该博弈的实用价值。在该示例中，计算一个均衡仅需在一颗Apple M5 Pro核心上耗时10.2秒。
tldr: 本文证明了一类含沉没成本、进入壁垒与不可逆退出的双寡头博弈中精炼马尔可夫完美均衡的存在性与本质唯一性，并开发了名为“伪逆向归纳法”的快速均衡计算算法，可高效用于随机增长市场中竞争政策的定量分析。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes existence and essential uniqueness of an intuitively refined Markov-perfect equilibrium in a duopoly game with sunk costs, entry barriers, and irreversible exit, and develops a fast "Fake Backward Induction" algorithm that computes the equilibrium in seconds for quantitative competition policy analysis in stochastically growing markets.
